A farm cannot rely on staffing its own jurors because a suspiciously unanimous panel is itself the tell. When a panel's verdicts on one submitter spread by more than 3 points the case is escalated to a second panel rather than settled, and a repeated pattern flags the submitter for audit. A 51 account operation therefore ties up 31 million dollars of idle capital. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
